shared_elements: low relief carving on a rectangular slab
justification: Both are low-relief slabs showing human figures in profile, but A is dominated by dense horizontal registers of small pictographic script signs with two small kneeling/adoring figures at the base, while B is a single continuous narrative scene of an archer in a horse-drawn chariot pursuing a collapsing horse and rider. The only correspondence is the generic one of profile human figures in shallow relief; there is no shared motif, relationship or layout.
